quote.text: What upsets people is not things themselves but their judgements about these things.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Understand that your reaction to your child's behavior is shaped by your own judgments; by reflecting on your interpretations, you can foster a calmer, kinder approach to guiding them.
    • Seeing challenges as opportunities to reassess your expectations helps you build a nurturing environment where both you and your child grow together.
  • Leadership
    • A wise leader recognizes that the stress or conflict in a team often stems from the way issues are perceived rather than the issues themselves; this understanding encourages measured and thoughtful responses.
    • By reinterpreting setbacks as chances for improvement, you can inspire your team to adopt a mindset of continuous learning and resilience.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, the feedback you receive is often colored by subjective judgments; separating these from objective facts can lead to clearer, more effective decision-making.
    • Adopting a reflective stance toward criticism allows you to identify real issues and innovate, turning potential setbacks into strategic improvements.
